originalTitle: JetBlue has been losing money for years. It just charted a path to profitability.
summary: JetBlue’s stock rises nearly 20% as a new profit target helps calm fears about the airline’s viability.
content:
JetBlue’s stock rises nearly 20% as a new profit target helps calm fears about the airline’s viability

JetBlue shares rallied on Tuesday after the beleaguered airline sought to allay worries about its business, saying it’s on the cusp of being profitable again — something it hasn’t managed to accomplish since 2019.

Investors zeroed in on comments by CEO Joanna Geraghty earlier Tuesday. JetBlue’s chief said on a call with analysts that the airline remains “focused on operating profitability in 2027” and sees “multiple paths to at least $1 in earnings per share and positive free cash flow in 2028.”

chineseSummary: 新的利润目标有助于缓解人们对该航空公司生存能力的担忧，捷蓝航空的股​​价上涨近 20%。
chineseContent:
新的利润目标有助于缓解人们对该航空公司生存能力的担忧，捷蓝航空股价上涨近 20%

捷蓝航空股价周二上涨，此前这家陷入困境的航空公司试图减轻对其业务的担忧，称其即将再次盈利——这是自 2019 年以来该公司一直未能实现的目标。

周二早些时候，投资者关注了首席执行官乔安娜·杰拉蒂(Joanna Geraghty)的言论。捷蓝航空首席执行官在与分析师的电话会议上表示，该航空公司仍然“专注于 2027 年的运营盈利能力”，并认为“到 2028 年实现至少 1 美元每股收益和正自由现金流的多种途径”。
